$comment: Fork-owned overrides applied to the upstream model catalog by tools/apply_license_overrides.mjs. The catalog (src-tauri/src/catalog/catalog.json) is generated upstream by scripts/gen_catalog.py, so a direct hand-edit would be lost on regeneration. Keeping the overrides in this separate, reviewed file makes them survive regeneration and makes the reasoning auditable.

overrides.reason: The catalog declares license 'other', which means the terms have NOT been confirmed. It was marked recommended (i.e. surfaced to new users as a default pick) upstream. Until the base model's terms are reviewed, it must not be presented as a default. Tracked in MODEL_LICENSES.md.

reviewed_but_unrestricted.note: Non-commercial. Already not a default upstream. Must never be made one, and must not be bundled or offered as part of a commercial distribution. The CI guard in tools/gen_model_licenses.mjs enforces the 'not a default' half of this.
